sourceTitle: Narragansett: 6. FIRE STATION EQUIPMENT, EXPANSION, IMPROVEMENT, AND RENOVATIONS
exactQuestion: Shall an act, passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly, entitled "An Act authorizing the Town of Narragansett to finance the equipping, expansion, improvement, and renovation of fire stations in the Town of Narragansett and to issue not more than $3,000,000 bonds and notes therefor" be approved?
